_comment: Print and channel constants for cover production. VERIFY BEFORE EACH RELEASE: retailer specs change. The authoritative check for any KDP print cover is the template KDP generates for your exact trim size, page count and paper type - these numbers exist so a cover can be designed before that template is pulled, not so the template can be skipped.

paperback._note: Public sources disagree on whether KDP paperback spine adds a ~0.06in cover-stock allowance. Default is 0.0 (page count x paper thickness). If KDP's generated template is wider than this calculation, rerun with --cover-thickness 0.06 and re-export.

barcode_zone.rule: Fill with a solid light colour (white, cream or light grey). No artwork, no text, no gradient, no dark background.

print_file.fonts: embedded, or text converted to outlines

kdp-ebook.label: Amazon KDP / Kindle ebook cover
kdp-ebook.notes: Front cover only. No spine, no back, no bleed. First contact with the reader is a thumbnail roughly 80-160px wide in search results.

kdp-print.label: Amazon KDP paperback / hardcover wrap
kdp-print.notes: Single full-wrap file: back cover, spine, front cover, left to right, with bleed on all four outer edges.

apple-books.label: Apple Books marketing image
apple-books.notes: Never upscale a smaller image to reach the minimum; blurry or pixelated art is rejected. A separate in-book cover image is also needed unless the tool generates one.

ebay.label: eBay listing image
ebay.notes: Square-ish gallery images crop better. For a physical book, photograph or mock up the printed product; for a digital download, show the cover plus a contents preview.

etsy.label: Etsy listing image
etsy.notes: Etsy buyers are shopping for printables. Listing image 1 is the cover; images 2-10 should show interior pages, what is included, and the print size.

audiobook.label: Audiobook cover
audiobook.notes: Square. Never crop the ebook cover to make this - it needs its own composition.
